style.styleTitle: Personalised Solid Copper Seven Year Anniversary Christmas Tree Decoration by Oakdene
style.toneOfVoice: Celebrate seven wonderful years together with this personalised copper Christmas decoration, a beautiful keepsake to mark your copper anniversary. Personalised with your favourite photo, your names, and the year your journey began, this meaningful ornament is a lovely way to celebrate your love and create lasting festive memories. Whether you re treating your partner or looking for a thoughtful anniversary or Christmas gift for a special couple, this decoration is sure to be treasured for years to come. Each ornament is precision cut from 0.9mm solid copper and professionally printed using our state-of-the-art direct printing technology, creating a vibrant, long-lasting finish. Complete with ribbon so it s ready to hang straight onto your tree, it measures approximately.
